title: Malicious code in statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.tshop (npm)
description: The npm package statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.tshop contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by the package, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
